memory_update.text: KMT should be tracked as the cleanest US-listed underfollowed downstream tungsten powder/carbide converter for the APT bottleneck, pending validation of non-China feedstock and materiality.

ALM is a necessary reference anchor for non-China tungsten concentrate supply, but needs separation from the actual APT-processing bottleneck; confirm oxide/APT capability before upgrading node purity.
APD is a large-cap reference for WF6 semiconductor gas exposure; include mainly to map the APT-to-WF6 downstream path, not as an underfollowed small/mid-cap discovery candidate.
AREC/ReElement is a below-$300M speculative exception: include only as a shadow candidate until tungsten product form, throughput, customer qualification, and AREC economic ownership are verified.

Need a follow-up pass for private or foreign-listed processors such as Global Tungsten & Powders/Plansee and Buffalo Tungsten/Sandvik because the true APT/powder chokepoint may sit outside US-listed pure plays.

Layer 1B mapping suggests the investable US-listed public chain is fragmented: ALM for concentrate, KMT for carbide/powder conversion, APD for WF6 specialty gas, and AREC as speculative refining optionality.

node: Tungsten APT processing and downstream tungsten intermediates
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe for the tungsten APT/intermediate chokepoint with a two-lane funnel. Reference lane anchors include a large-cap WF6 specialty-gas supplier and a Nasdaq-listed tungsten concentrate producer. The underfollowed lane emphasizes downstream tungsten powder/carbide conversion and speculative US critical-mineral refining optionality. The strongest direct public-market mapping found in this pass is Kennametal for tungsten powder/carbide conversion; the cleanest upstream non-China tungsten reference is Almonty; the clearest downstream semiconductor intermediate reference is Air Products via tungsten hexafluoride; the highest-risk shadow candidate is American Resources/ReElement, where recent tungsten purification claims need commercial-capacity and customer validation.
